core_invariant.statement: For a six-dimensional K-Hermitian space, a K-linear similitude h' = c*g^* h*g with c in Q^* changes det(h) by c^6*Nm(det g). Both factors are norms in Q^*/Nm(K^*): c^6=Nm(c^3), and Nm(det g) is a norm by definition. Therefore the discriminant class is invariant under K-linear similitude.
core_invariant.consequence: No K-linear polarized isogeny/similitude can send the split class [-1] to target class [-3].

operations.reason: Discriminant is a discrete connected-component invariant, so an ordinary deformation path cannot cross from [-1] to [-3].

operations.operation: K-linear isogeny with compatible polarization up to rational similitude
operations.reason: The induced rational H^1 map is a K-linear Hermitian similitude and preserves the discriminant class by the determinant formula above.

operations.operation: unitary Hecke correspondence preserving the K-polarized Weil datum
operations.reason: Hecke moves are implemented by rational/adelic unitary similitudes of the fixed Hermitian space and remain in the same discriminant class.
At determinant level duality can invert the discriminant class. The split class [-1] is self-inverse, so duality does not produce [-3].

If the equivalence is required to identify the target K-action, polarization/similitude structure and Weil carrier, its H^1 realization falls under K-compatible similitude data and cannot change [-1] to [-3]. If it is not K-compatible, it does not supply the required identification of the target W_K carrier and therefore fails the H0M transport typing gate.

operations.operation: arbitrary new algebraic correspondence not induced by the above K-linear transport mechanisms
operations.reason: The discriminant argument does not rule out a genuinely new correspondence acting directly on codimension-3 classes. Such a correspondence must be explicitly constructed and proved to map a known algebraic class to the target W_K; none is currently available.

scope_warning: This is not a theorem that no algebraic correspondence can ever connect the components. It rules out the standard deformation/isogeny/unitary-Hecke/K-compatible-derived transport route that would otherwise recycle the split source object.
